name: NagaAI
description: NagaAI offers free model calls without a top-up, capped daily.
overview: NagaAI's free Nemotron 3 Ultra endpoint is available to free accounts without topping up. Its published free-model limits are shared across all free models: 10 requests per minute and 100 per day. The service supports OpenAI-compatible calls at api.naga.ac/v1; the exact free model identifier shown in the provider's example ends in :free.
free_access: Free account can call without topping up
notes: Use nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free, not the paid alias. Signup card requirement is not explicitly documented on the cited model page.
